title: One-Session Reset
description: Evidence-backed 5-step Single-Session Intervention: name the distress, settle the body, reframe gently, and choose one micro-commitment.
instructions: Name what feels heaviest
Follow the 90-second paced somatic settle
Give yourself gentle compassionate words
Commit to one 2-minute real-world action
Check in on your nervous system shift

title: Cyclic Sighing
description: Double inhale followed by a prolonged, soothing exhale to rapidly calm the autonomic nervous system.
instructions: Take a deep breath in through your nose
Top it off with a second quick inhale
Slowly sigh all the air out through your mouth

title: Box Breathing
description: Equal 4-second intervals of inhale, hold, exhale, and hold for steady focus and emotional equilibrium.
instructions: Inhale for 4 seconds
Hold gently for 4 seconds
Exhale smoothly for 4 seconds
Hold empty for 4 seconds

title: Resonance Coherence
description: Smooth 5.5-second inhales and exhales (~5.5 breaths per minute) maximizing heart rate variability.
instructions: Inhale steadily for 5.5 seconds
Exhale smoothly for 5.5 seconds without pauses

title: 4-7-8 Deep Rest
description: Prolonged exhale breathing designed to trigger deep parasympathetic relaxation before sleep.
instructions: Inhale quietly through nose for 4 seconds
Hold your breath gently for 7 seconds
Exhale completely through mouth with whoosh sound for 8 seconds

title: Star Breathing
description: Follow the points of a star with gentle breath pacing for visual anchoring.
instructions: Breathe in as you trace up a point
Pause at the tip
Breathe out as you trace down the side

title: Belly Breathing
description: Deep diaphragmatic respiration placing hands on abdomen to anchor physical attention.
instructions: Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly
Inhale so your belly expands more than your chest
Exhale slowly through pursed lips

title: Full Body PMR Sequence
description: Systematic 10-zone muscle tension and release from head to toe to eliminate stored tension.
instructions: Tense forehead for 5s
Release and notice the warmth for 10s
Move progressively through jaw, shoulders, hands, core, and feet

title: Shoulder & Neck Release
description: Targeted 3-minute somatic reset for upper body tension caused by stress or desk work.
instructions: Lift shoulders toward your ears and squeeze for 5s
Drop them completely with an exhale
Notice the sensation of gravity pulling tension away

title: Jaw & Facial Unclench
description: Gentle release for facial tension, teeth clenching, and eyebrow furrowing.
instructions: Scrunch your entire face gently for 4s
Open your mouth slightly and let your tongue rest on the floor of your mouth
Breathe softly into the space behind your eyes

title: Hand & Fist Release
description: Tight fist squeezing and sudden release to dissipate adrenaline and agitation.
instructions: Clench both hands into firm fists for 5s
Release suddenly and open fingers wide
Notice the tingling warmth spreading through your palms

title: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding
description: Engage all five senses sequentially to anchor your attention firmly in the physical world.
instructions: Notice 5 things you can see
4 things you can touch
3 things you can hear
2 things you can smell
1 thing you can taste

title: Tactile Texture Hunt
description: Find and touch 3 distinct textures around you to break internal cognitive spinning.
instructions: Find something smooth (e.g. glass or phone screen)
Find something rough or textured (e.g. fabric or wood)
Find something cool to the touch

title: Acoustic Sound Hunt
description: Orient your hearing to three layers of sound in your current environment.
instructions: Listen for the nearest sound (even your breath)
Listen for a sound inside the room
Listen for the farthest distant sound outside

title: Calm Colour Search
description: Scan your space to spot 4 items that share a soothing visual shade.
instructions: Look around and find 4 green or blue objects
Notice the shape and light on each one before moving to the next

title: Feet on Floor Anchoring
description: Proprioceptive awareness of foot contact with the earth, gravity, and stability.
instructions: Plant both feet flat on the floor
Press your toes and heels gently downward
Feel the solid floor supporting your weight completely

title: Category Word Association
description: Name items in comforting categories to occupy working memory and displace intrusive thoughts.
instructions: Name 5 types of warm soup or beverage
Name 5 calm places you have visited or seen
Name 5 book or movie titles

title: Counting Down by 3s
description: Structured arithmetic sequence from 50 to zero providing gentle, absorbing mental focus.
instructions: Start at 50
Take your time with each number without rushing

title: Alphabet Serenity Walk
description: Move through the alphabet thinking of one calming, peaceful word for each letter.
instructions: A is for Autumn breeze
B is for Blanket
C is for Candlelight
Continue as far as feels pleasant

title: Opposite Concept Flips
description: Rapid presentation of words where you pair the opposite concept to restore mental flexibility.
instructions: Notice the concept shown
Whisper or tap its gentle opposite
Notice how meaning flips easily

title: Full Body Shakeout
description: 30 to 60 seconds of gentle physical shaking to release adrenaline and restlessness.
instructions: Stand up with soft knees
Shake your hands as if flicking water off your fingertips
Let your shoulders, arms, and hips loosen completely for 45 seconds

title: Wall Push-Ups
description: Controlled, steady push against a firm wall to provide calming proprioceptive joint input.
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a sturdy wall
Place hands flat at shoulder height
Slowly lower your chest towards the wall and push back with steady control

title: Grounded 5-Minute Stroll
description: Slow, intentional walking focusing on heel-to-toe foot placement and natural rhythm.
instructions: Walk at a comfortable, unhurried pace
Feel your heel strike, roll across the foot, and push off with toes
Look ahead softly rather than at your feet

title: Gentle Shoulder Rolls
description: Slow circular rotations of the shoulder blades to loosen chest and upper spine.
instructions: Roll your shoulders forward, up to your ears, back, and down
Perform 5 slow forward circles and 5 slow backward circles

title: March in Place
description: Rhythmic, alternating leg lifting to activate circulation when energy is low.
instructions: Lift your knees rhythmically one after the other
Swing your arms naturally with the movement
Continue at an easy, comfortable pace for 90 seconds

title: Calm Stone Mosaic
description: Gently place smooth geometric stone shapes into an open grid without time limits or fail states.
instructions: Drag shapes into the grid
Fit pieces together at your own pace
No scores, no timer — simply enjoy the tactile click

title: Spectrum Hue Order
description: Arrange subtle pastel color swatches into gentle chromatic gradients.
instructions: Notice the subtle shifts in tone
Slide tiles until the color gradient flows smoothly from light to deep

title: Zen Path Tracing
description: Trace a gentle glowing ember along a winding path without walls or collision penalties.
instructions: Place your finger on the glowing ember
Follow the curving river path slowly and steadily

title: Finger Labyrinth
description: Follow a meditative winding circular path to the center and back without decisions.
instructions: A labyrinth has only one path — you cannot get lost
Trace slowly from the entrance into the peaceful center
Pause at the center, then trace your way out

title: Continuous Spiral Tracing
description: Slow repetitive circular tracing creating hypnotic visual and motor soothing.
instructions: Trace inward along the spiral in an unhurried circle
Feel the smooth curve guide your finger

title: Gentle Body Scan
description: Slow non-judgmental awareness passing through the body to release stored tension.
instructions: Bring your awareness to the top of your head
Notice any sensation without trying to change it
Gradually let attention drift down through chest, hips, and toes

title: Loving-Kindness Reflection
description: Cultivate warmth and self-compassion through gentle silent affirmations.
instructions: Hold a warm image of someone or a pet you care for
Silently repeat: May you be safe. May you be peaceful. May you be kind to yourself

title: Sound Immersion Meditation
description: Allow ambient sounds to wash over you without labeling or judging them.
instructions: Close your eyes or lower your gaze
Let sounds enter your awareness like ripples in water
Simply listen without needing to identify the source

title: Unsent Letter
description: Express difficult or honest words completely privately with no possibility of being sent.
instructions: Write whatever needs to be said to someone or yourself
Knowing this letter is completely private and can never be transmitted

title: Nighttime Worry Dump
description: Move anxious thoughts from your mind onto dark paper so you can park them until tomorrow.
instructions: Write down the things running through your mind
Choose to park them until tomorrow morning or let them dissolve

title: Emotion Naming & Granularity
description: Name nuanced feelings from an interactive emotion wheel to diminish amygdala arousal.
instructions: Look past broad words like 'bad' or 'fine'
Find the precise texture: tender, heavy, restless, fragile, or numb
Naming it helps quiet the reaction

title: Take a Slow Sip of Water
description: One simple, hydrating micro-action providing immediate sensory and physical reset.
instructions: Get a small glass of fresh water
Take two slow, deliberate sips, feeling the cool temperature

title: Open a Window or Curtain
description: Let natural daylight or fresh air into your space with one small physical gesture.
instructions: Walk to the nearest window
Draw back the curtain or crack open the window for 30 seconds of breeze

title: Make a Warm Cup of Tea
description: A comforting routine combining slow sensory rhythm, warmth, and nourishment.
instructions: Boil water slowly
Hold the warm mug in both hands
Inhale the herbal aroma before taking a sip

title: Cool Water Splash
description: Splash cool water on your face to trigger the mammalian dive reflex and lower heart rate.
instructions: Run cool tap water
Gently cup water and splash your forehead, cheeks, and eyes
Pat dry with a soft towel

title: Step Outside for 1 Minute
description: Change your sensory environment by stepping onto a porch, balcony, or doorstep.
instructions: Step past your doorway into the outside air
Take three natural breaths while looking at the horizon
Step back inside whenever you wish

title: Rain on Forest Canopy
description: High-fidelity gapless acoustic recording of gentle rainfall among broadleaf trees.
instructions: Put on headphones if available
Let the natural white noise of rain droplets mask distracting sounds

title: Distant Ocean Swell
description: Rhythmic, low-frequency ocean waves matching the cadence of relaxed human respiration.
instructions: Listen to the swell arrive and recede
Sync your breath naturally with the ebb and flow

title: Sky & Cloud Watching
description: Soft panoramic visual gazing at shifting clouds or the open blue sky to restore attention.
instructions: Look upward towards the open sky or out a window
Rest your focus softly on the edge of a cloud
Notice how shapes slowly dissolve and reform

title: Personal Sound Sanctuary
description: Blend rain, fireplace, soft piano, and brown noise into your own custom comfort cocoon.
instructions: Adjust sliders for rain, tone, and environment
Find the balance that feels safest right now

title: Soft Ambient Piano
description: Sparse, unhurried piano melodies in gentle major chords designed for acoustic comfort.
instructions: Close your eyes and let the warm notes fill the room
Notice the silence between the chords

title: Bedtime Audio Sleep Fade
description: Ambient soundscape that gradually diminishes in volume over the final 5 minutes.
instructions: Choose your preferred duration: 15, 30, or 45 minutes
Lay your phone face down on your nightstand
The sound will dissolve smoothly without sudden silence

title: Circadian Wake Anchor
description: Set a gentle, consistent morning wake target to strengthen your circadian rhythm.
instructions: Pick a realistic wake time that you can hold 7 days a week
Even on rough nights, waking at the same time rebuilds sleep pressure

title: One-Tap Reaching Out
description: Send a pre-written text message to a trusted contact without feeling awkward.
instructions: Select someone from your safe contact list
Use or tweak a warm pre-written note like: 'Hey, thinking of you. Free to chat?'
Remember: people appreciate being reached out to more than we expect

title: Guess vs Reality Experiment
description: Predict how someone will respond before texting, then log the actual warmth afterwards.
instructions: Rate how warmly you expect the person to respond
After you hear back, log what actually occurred
Over time, notice how reality is usually gentler than our fear

title: Calm Geometric Doodling
description: Draw repetitive, non-verbal geometric loops or waves to channel restless nervous energy.
instructions: Use your finger to draw repeating waves or hatched lines
No artistic skill required — simply follow the rhythm of the lines

title: Paper Fold Focus
description: Follow simple step-by-step folds using any square scrap of paper nearby.
instructions: Find a piece of paper
Follow the 4 simple geometric creases to make a tranquil cup or boat
Focus on crisp edges and tactile folds

title: Leaves on a Stream
description: Visualize your thoughts as leaves floating down a quiet river, watching them pass by.
instructions: Picture a slow-moving woodland stream
Whenever a thought arises, place it on a leaf
Watch it float downstream out of sight without grabbing onto it

title: Thought Cloud Dissolve
description: Type a heavy thought and watch it transform into a soft cloud that slowly drifts away.
instructions: Type a thought weighing on your mind
Tap 'Release'
Watch the words soften into white mist and dissolve across the dark sky

title: Thought Labelling & Distance
description: Step back from fused thoughts using 3-step mindful distance: 'I notice I am having the thought that...'
instructions: Read the fused thought
Insert 'I notice I am having the thought that...'
Recognize yourself as the calm observer

title: Visit Your Hope Box
description: Glance at private photos, comforting voice notes, and reasons to keep holding on.
instructions: Open your safe hope box
Look at one photo or listen to a 10-second voice note from someone who cares
Remind yourself why staying here matters

title: Sky & Cloud Gazing
description: Broaden visual attention and observe passing clouds or open daylight without focusing on a single spot.
instructions: Direct your gaze upward toward open sky or light
Follow the slow drift of clouds and air
Rest in the wide calm above

title: Tree Canopy & Leaves
description: Observe natural branching fractals, leaf rustling, and plant shapes to calm sympathetic arousal.
instructions: Look at a tree, branch, or houseplant
Trace the branching patterns from thick to thin
Notice the rooted stability of living growth

title: Light & Shadow Play
description: Attend to gentle contrasts of sunlight and shadows across walls or ground surfaces.
instructions: Locate where natural light enters the space
Observe where light meets shadow on a surface
Notice the slow, steady progression of daylight

title: Earth & Elements Grounding
description: Sense firm ground underfoot, ambient air temperature, and natural tactile textures.
instructions: Bring awareness to the solid earth under your feet
Notice temperature on skin
Touch a natural texture nearby

title: Weather & Atmosphere
description: Listen to atmospheric sounds and notice air currents to ground in the present moment.
instructions: Listen to background weather sounds
Notice air movement across your skin
Reflect that all weather—internal and external—passes

title: Heavy Body Gravity Settling
description: Notice downward gravitational pull and release postural bracing in jaw, shoulders, and limbs.
instructions: Notice the solid surface holding you up
Let go of muscular vigilance in your jaw and shoulders
Allow gravity to carry your weight

title: Warm Hands Peripheral Dilation
description: Autogenic visualization of soothing warmth radiating into palms and fingertips to calm sympathetic drive.
instructions: Center awareness in both palms
Imagine gentle warmth soaking into fingertips
Notice peripheral blood flow soothing your pulse

title: Mountain Posture Stability
description: Embody the rooted base and dignified stillness of a mountain to weather passing thoughts and stress.
instructions: Feel your physical base firmly rooted
Align spine with natural, unforced dignity
Let transient feelings blow past like wind while you stay steady

title: Mindful Pause & Body Anchor
description: Rapid 3-step physical anchor circuit: Stop, Drop attention to physical contact, Breathe and soften.
instructions: Pause whatever you were doing
Drop awareness into feet on the floor or hands on lap
Take one slow breath out and soften muscular tension

title: Classical Cretan Labyrinth
description: Unicursal geometric finger tracing winding slowly inward to center stillness.
instructions: Place your finger at the outer opening
Follow the winding track inward at an unhurried pace
Rest in the quiet center circle

title: Concentric Inward Spiral
description: Continuous spiral tracing drawing scattered attention into quiet focal concentration.
instructions: Trace the smooth curving track
Feel your breath settle as you approach the center
Pause at the midpoint in quiet stillness

title: Rhythmic Infinity Loop
description: Flowing bilateral figure-8 motor tracing to discharge nervous restlessness.
instructions: Trace the continuous figure-8 loops smoothly
Maintain a gentle, unforced rhythm
Repeat as many cycles as feels soothing

title: Harmonic Meander Waves
description: Rhythmic geometric waves providing predictable, steady tactile grounding.
instructions: Follow the crests and valleys of the rhythmic path
Let your hand move with easy fluid motion

title: Constellation Star Flow
description: Gently connect celestial stars to reveal serene constellations, absorbing working memory.
instructions: Touch star 1 to begin
Follow the glowing numbers across the tranquil sky
Watch the celestial shape emerge

title: Harmony Sliding Tiles
description: Slowly slide numbered tactile tiles into harmonious order with zero pressure, timers, or score.
instructions: Tap any highlighted tile adjacent to the space
Move stones with unhurried tactile rhythm
Restore gentle balance to the grid
